200.description: One advisory estimate per requested item, in request order. Nothing was stored and no capacity is reserved; the options can change before the shopper quotes.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Never set on this operation. An Idempotency-Key is ignored, so no answer is a replay. Declared because the fleet REST lint requires the header on every POST 2xx.

schema.description: Advisory estimates relayed from delivery-promise; nothing was stored and no capacity is reserved.

computedAt.description: The instant every estimate of the response was computed at.

estimates.description: One per requested item, in request order.

options.description: The best option per classic tier that has one, ordered by tier.

window.description: The option's window as two instants (RFC 3339 UTC) and the local calendar they belong to. start and end are what a quote's offer calls window.earliest and window.latest (the product page's deliverByEarliest and deliverByLatest); convert both into timeZone before taking their date.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the delivery station serving the destination.

window.title: DeliveryEstimateWindow

basis.description: How the window was derived (delivery-promise basis).

confidence.description: The calibrated probability that the window is kept; absent means unknown, never zero.

orderByAt.description: The latest instant an order can be placed and still make this window; omitted when unknown.

capacityBand.description: The capacity pressure on the delivery-promise book of the offer's or option's chosen window when it was quoted or estimated (delivery-promise ADR 0023): AMPLE below 0.60 utilisation, TIGHT from 0.60 to below 0.85, SCARCE from 0.85. A signal only: it changes no offer, window or charge, reserves nothing, and is omitted when the producer has no reading.
capacityBand.title: CapacityBand

carrierArea.description: True when the final leg is the chosen carrier of a carrier-handoff area; omitted otherwise.

constraints.description: The item-wide constraints first (no tier), then one per blocked tier, ordered by tier.

tier.description: Omitted when the constraint holds for the item on every tier alike.

schema.title: DeliveryEstimates

400.description: A 400 problem: idempotency-key-required, idempotency-key-invalid, unknown-query-parameter, invalid-limit, invalid-cursor (relayed from the provider) or malformed-request (a NUL character in the query string or body, or an unreadable body).

409.description: Never answered by this operation (a key is ignored, so it is never idempotency-key-reused); declared because the fleet REST lint requires a 409 on every POST.

413.description: A 413 payload-too-large problem from the edge: the request body is over 1 MiB (checked before any upstream call).

422.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504), route-not-allowed (500), internal-error (500) and client-closed-request (499, the caller went away). Any route also answers 404 resource-not-found for a path it does not serve (or one containing NUL) and 405 method-not-allowed for a wrong method.

503.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504), route-not-allowed (500), internal-error (500) and client-closed-request (499, the caller went away). Any route also answers 404 resource-not-found for a path it does not serve (or one containing NUL) and 405 method-not-allowed for a wrong method.

504.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504), route-not-allowed (500), internal-error (500) and client-closed-request (499, the caller went away). Any route also answers 404 resource-not-found for a path it does not serve (or one containing NUL) and 405 method-not-allowed for a wrong method.
